Name: House Remodel - Interior Design
Author: Minakie
Description:
[size=3][i][left][u][b][s][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zXgDX0nc/about-the-mod.png[/img]﻿[/s][/b][/u]
[/left][/i]
I made the chocolate version inspired by my real kitchen. Then I decided to add the beige version as well since that was the color scheme I was using on my game at the time. The rooms look the same on both versions. There’s also an optional fireplace. And a column that can have different looks for different House Upgrade levels.

[/size][center][size=3]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/753-3-1480539055.png[/img][/size][/center][size=3][spoiler]- [b]Kitchen[/b]: I changed the place where the sink is to make it more similar to my own kitchen and added a detergent and trash can below it. I changed the microwave,  sink and stove. Added a copper pan and a kitchen fan on top of the stove, as well has two spoons on the wall. The white thing with horns on the cabinet is a kitchen scale. I made my own version of the fridge and added a potted plant on top. Also made the washing machine. There's a brass key on top of a cabinet and a coin on top of the corner one. Then there's a coffee cup and a coffee machine that I also pixeled for the game. There were some [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/derpy-ghost-kitchen-wall-shadow.127269/#post-3067783]shadow issues[/url] so I added a mosaic pattern on the wall, also inspired by my own kitchen.
- The (optional) fireplace was inspired by the white fireplaces made by [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/cute-valley-now-in-blue-updated-10-22.110882]Rosalie[/url] and [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/f%C3%A4rsk-kitchen.115559]buckyobarnes[/url] and modified to meet the requirements I wanted my fireplace to have. Just little details that the OCD in me had to fix.
[b]- Bedrooms[/b]: I took the old bed and crib I was using and updated them. That blanket on the master bed is like the one I have in real life and I decided to open the bottom to have a see-through of the pattern. As for the crib, it has a pillow, a teddy bear, a tilted baby bottle (behind the bars) and a toy horse on the floor.
[b]- Bookcase column[/b]: I basically took [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/665/]StaticOpium[/url]'s idea and made it my own. Added a dinosaur, books and a jar from the game and then pixeled a baby bottle, toy owl and toy doll.[/spoiler]


[s][size=2]And... there’s a little “Easter egg” teaser hidden somewhere. I wonder if anyone can find it. ;)[/size][/s]
The teaser was the green parakeet hidden in the .png file but not visible in the print screens. Budgie and his friends are now available to turn on/off at will on the CP version. I've also added cats and 7 new options for the column.
[/size][center][size=3]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/753/753-1576622071-578844914.png[/img]
[/size][/center]
You can have a bird, cat, or decor piece atop the fireplace. You can have both the bird and cat simultaneously, but the decor items are meant to be used separately and might look funny if you try to use them at the same time as one of the animals.

The beds and crib also have configurable options. The "config instructions" file will (hopefully) tell you all you need to know.


[u][size=3][b][u][img]https://i.postimg.cc/RFY9vHqm/special-thanks.png[/img]﻿[/u][/b]
[/size][/u]
[size=3]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51171631]Gweniaczek[/url] for letting me use the pigeon from their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4785]Pigeon Mailbox[/url] mod
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/77058318]hushsmile[/url] for letting me use the color palettes of their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4976]Calcium's Nyangcarecrow[/url] mod[/size]


[u][size=3][b][u][img]https://i.postimg.cc/d0qJ6Fgb/installation.png[/img]﻿[/u][/b]
[/size][/u]
[size=3]- Make sure you have [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][size=3] and [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][size=3] installed as well[/size]
[size=3]- Download my latest file and unzip it[/size]
[size=3]- Navigate to your "[/size][i]Stardew Valley\Mods"[/i][size=3] folder and drop the extracted folder there[/size]
[size=3]- Run the game to generate the config file (just leave it as-is or tweak the options to your liking)
- Have fun :)[/size]

Manifest.Name: Minakie's House Remodel - Interior Design
Manifest.Description: This mod provides color variations for the kitchen, beds, crib, fireplace, and column. It also adds optional decorations, birds and cats to place atop the fireplace.
Manifest.Author: Minakie
